newsitem.title: USA: Service Experts file for 3.2 mln common.
newsitem.headline: Service Experts file for 3.2 mln common.

text.p: Service Experts, Inc said Tuesday it filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to 3.2 million common shares.
Of the total, 1.85 million common will be sold by the company and 1.35 million will be offered by selling stockholders. After the offering, outstanding shares will total 13,671,722 common.

The underwriters have been granted a 30-day over-allotment option to buy up 480,000 additional common. The offering will be made through Equitable Securities Corp, Alex. Brown & Sons Inc, A.G. Edwards & Sons Inc and Morgan Keegan & Co Inc.

Net proceeds will be used to fund the cash portion of the consideration for pending acquisitions, including repayment of certain indebtedness arising from pending acquitisions, certain other indebtedness and capital lease obligations.
The balance of the proceeds will be used for future acquisitions and general corporate purposes, the company said.
Service, based in Nashville, Tenn., is a provider of residential HVAC services and replacement equipment in the United States.
